Diagnosis.submission: The frontend-proxy deployment was modified to replace the original Envoy proxy with a single-threaded Perl WAF script using the ReDoS-vulnerable regex ^([a-zA-Z]+)*$. The load generator periodically sends requests with a waf query parameter containing a 5001-character payload that triggers catastrophic backtracking in the Perl regex engine, causing the proxy to block all traffic for ~3 seconds per attack request. This results in intermittent latency spikes and request failures across the entire storefront. The faulty component is the frontend-proxy, which was replaced by a malicious or misconfigured WAF deployment (revision 2 of the deployment, change ticket EDGE-1847).
